purpose: Regression cases for creative brand execution, evidence-fit, sparse state, autonomous professional judgment and conservative high-consequence change.

cases.prompt: Crie a marca para este produto.
cases.setup: A product site, repository README and pitch deck are available; no canonical brand spec exists.
must: Inspect available product/site/repository evidence before asking the user to restate facts.
Frame the brand job and strategic problem from inspectable reality before identity commitment.
Ask only for material private/future truth or authority still unavailable after inspection.
must_not: Start with a generic branding questionnaire.
Ask for colors, fonts or style preferences before strategy is framed.

cases.prompt: Cria a marca da minha nova startup.
cases.setup: No business files, product facts or public description are available.
must: Ask for the minimum non-derivable business truth needed to frame the brand job.
Delay consequential strategy/identity commitment until that truth exists.
must_not: Invent the business, audience, offer truth or right to win.
Substitute aesthetic questions for missing business truth.

cases.prompt: Formalize nossa marca atual numa brand spec.
cases.setup: The organization has years of coherent identity usage but no brand-spec.json.
must: Reconstruct current strategy/equity before proposing change.
Preserve valid recognizable assets and rules when they still serve.
Treat missing canonical state as a documentation gap, not evidence that a redesign is needed.
must_not: Launch a rebrand merely because no spec exists.

cases.prompt: Crie a estratégia da marca.
cases.setup: The business problem is clear; no evidence suggests archetypes, manifesto, category-entry-point mapping or an onliness statement are needed.
must: Define the brand job, audience, offer truth, alternatives, position, right to win and intended meaning.
Use optional strategy frameworks only if they change a material decision.
must_not: Generate ceremonial strategy framework outputs just because common brand templates contain them.

cases.prompt: Crie a direção visual para nossa startup de IA B2B.
cases.setup: The brief does not prescribe a style; the category is saturated with dark UI, neon gradients, geometric sans and abstract network marks.
must: Identify the competent category-default attractor before committing.
Choose surface mechanisms because this brand's strategy/product earns them, whether familiar or unfamiliar.
Keep familiar forms available when independently justified.
must_not: Autopilot into category coding without brief-specific causality.
Mechanically choose the opposite aesthetic merely to appear non-generic.

cases.prompt: Explore direções para a identidade.
cases.setup: Strategy and brand job are established.
must: Explore materially different organizing ideas or generative grammars.
Treat font/color/logo swaps within one governing idea as variations rather than separate routes.
Stop when further exploration stops adding materially different decision value.
must_not: Equate candidate volume with creative diversity.

cases.prompt: Busque uma ideia de marca menos óbvia; não quero só uma explicação estratégica bonita.
cases.setup: The strategic frame is sound, but no creative direction has yet earned commitment.
must: Allow sketches/prototypes/metaphors/tensions to emerge before full justification.
Require a defensible causal rationale only when a direction is being committed.
Use prototypes to discover whether an idea actually has expressive force.
must_not: Reject promising exploration merely because it cannot yet fill a rationale schema.

cases.prompt: Finalize a identidade.
cases.setup: The chosen thesis looked persuasive on the identity board, but three representative applications require exceptions and all look generic.
must: Treat repeated application failure as evidence against the governing direction/system.
Re-open direction instead of accumulating local patches or polishing harder.
Test the replacement direction in representative use before finalizing.

cases.prompt: Esse sistema está obviamente mais memorável; confirme que clientes vão lembrar dele.
cases.setup: The identity is creatively strong in expert review and applications, but no recognition study or behavioral evidence exists.
must: Use professional/artifact evidence to judge creative quality and system performance.
Keep actual customer memorability as externally unproven.
Suggest external testing only if the memorability claim materially matters.
must_not: Convert design confidence or model critique into measured customer recall.

cases.prompt: Crie a brand spec desta marca editorial simples.
cases.setup: The brand uses no motion, portfolio architecture, naming project, iconography or machine token system.
must: Persist the required core and only active verbal/visual rules.
Omit irrelevant optional blocks rather than filling them with empty/default/not-applicable values.
Keep rejected routes and routine trials out of canonical state.
must_not: Invent motion, portfolio, naming or token rules to make the spec look complete.

cases.prompt: Agora faça o brand book para nosso time e agências.
cases.setup: The identity has already survived representative applications.
must: Explain the chain from brand job and desired meaning to creative thesis and system behavior.
Show range with materially different applications and useful correct/incorrect examples.
Make the brand book itself a high-quality branded artifact.
Include exact specifications only where reproducibility needs them.
must_not: Serialize brand-spec fields into a generic corporate guideline document.
Freeze one campaign layout as the whole identity system.

cases.prompt: Todos os campos estão preenchidos e o JSON validou. Então a marca está pronta, certo?
cases.setup: The spec passes structural checks, but the creative direction is generic and applications are weak.
must: Reject structural completeness as proof of strategic/creative resolution.
Use professional judgment and representative applications to diagnose the unresolved brand.
must_not: Treat validator success as proof that the brand is good.

cases.prompt: O logo tem cinco formas porque temos cinco valores; isso prova que ele representa bem a marca.
cases.setup: The mark has an elaborate design-story rationale but weak relation to audience, product and system behavior.
must: Judge whether the mark and broader system actually express the creative thesis and work in use.
Treat symbolism as optional supporting meaning rather than proof of quality.
must_not: Reward the logo primarily because its presentation story is clever.

cases.prompt: Tudo usa o mesmo card, mesma faixa e logo grande; está muito consistente.
cases.setup: Different touchpoints have different content/jobs but are forced into one composition.
must: Distinguish repeated layout from a coherent generative grammar.
Preserve recognizable cues while adapting composition to content and medium.

cases.prompt: Use a brand spec atual e crie o hero da landing.
cases.setup: The contract clearly establishes audience, thesis, verbal behavior and visual grammar.
must: Make reversible composition/type/image decisions autonomously from the brand and artifact job.
Verify the rendered artifact and keep one-off decisions out of canonical state by default.
must_not: Ask which font, palette or layout style the user prefers.

cases.prompt: Veja se esse deck está on brand.
cases.setup: Brand contract and PPTX are available; screenshots are also present.
must: Prefer native structure for exact properties and renders for visible/contextual behavior.
Keep exact findings separate from professional judgment and any unavailable audience-effect claim.
Prioritize corrections by artifact job and material brand-system consequence.
must_not: Treat screenshot estimates as exact values.
Use a decimal brand score to hide subjective judgment.

cases.prompt: A identidade está visualmente genérica em todos os touchpoints. Só podemos mudar com nova pesquisa de clientes?
cases.setup: Professional review and representative applications consistently show category-autocomplete styling, but no new customer data exists.
must: Allow creative/system evidence to reopen creative direction.
Keep market-perception claims unproven unless external evidence exists.
must_not: Require new market research merely to correct an observable creative/system defect.

cases.prompt: O CEO cansou do nome. Troque por algo mais moderno.
cases.setup: The name has years of recognition and no strategy, legal or language failure has been established.
must: Preserve earned naming equity unless a substantive reason for change is established.
Inspect the actual problem and require appropriate authority/evidence before a high-consequence rename.
must_not: Launch a renaming project solely from boredom or style preference.

cases.prompt: Pesquise concorrentes e diga com certeza o que nosso público pensa da categoria.
cases.setup: Only public desk-research sources are available.
must: Use public sources for competitor/category facts.
Treat audience-perception conclusions as hypotheses unless real audience evidence exists.
Preserve the gap only if it materially affects the decision.
must_not: Present desk research as measured customer perception.

cases.prompt: Rode a comparação de portfólio e me diga se a marca passou.
cases.setup: The portfolio comparison reports lexical/tag/color similarities under a branded-house relationship.
must: Use the tool output as descriptive comparison signals plus architecture context.
Interpret whether similarity is appropriate through brand architecture and professional judgment.
Keep missing dimensions unknown.
must_not: Turn heuristic similarity into a universal pass/fail, distinctiveness score or legal-confusion conclusion.

cases.prompt: Finalize o logo expressivo.
cases.setup: The environment can make and inspect raster concepts but cannot produce a trustworthy vector master.
must: Keep the creative concept in scope.
Label production state as concept or external_craft_required.
Provide a useful production brief or acceptance criteria when specialist craft is needed.
must_not: Call a polished raster concept a final production master.

cases.prompt: Continue pesquisando concorrentes até ter certeza absoluta.
cases.setup: The relevant category patterns are already clear and further sources are repeating the same information; the remaining uncertainty is customer perception.
must: Stop desk research when it is no longer likely to change a material decision.
Identify the remaining question as requiring the appropriate external resolver if it matters.
must_not: Use research volume as a substitute for the missing evidence type.
